items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1958-07-20
items.q: Renier used to have a brass band, you know, just pick up, you know, started a band, and I worked with him

ctx.x: When did you join the Eureka?

When did you join the Eureka? When did you see, I came out, I must have joined the Eureka around in about, a lot of part of 46, I mean. Because Richardson was playing with them, and every time Richardson was to be there, he wasn't there, and they'd call me and things, so eventually they just took me in the band there. But I waited, or way back, but Renier used to have a brass band, you know, just pick up, you know, started a band, and I worked with him, you know what I mean. I wasn't, you know, this was coming…
Didn't you, at one time, play with George Lewis?

items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1959-01-20
items.q: he used to play with Rene and all them fellas.

ctx.x: I was wondering if you ever noticed, would they use a flat pick or would they use finger picks and thumb picks or all different kinds of things?

Well in that time, them fellows would use just their fingers. I see here lately now, I see them fellows with them picks, you know, them sideline picks, but them fellows way back then, I mean they'd just be picking that with their fingers. I mean they'd play it too. Old fellow Jim Lucas, he used to play some guitar, played banjo, but he played in bands and he used to play with Rene and all them fellas. Is he still around? Hmm? Is he still around? No, Jim Lucas, he died, he been dead. He was a good banjo player,…
You can hardly find a good blues picker like you used to. There's very few of them around.
